method.name: NbMaxElements
method.description: Return number of initially allocated elements which can fit into this buffer, while NbElements can be overwritten to smaller value.

method.name: IsInterleaved
method.description: Flag indicating that attributes in the buffer are interleaved; TRUE by default. Requires sub-classing for creating a non-interleaved buffer (advanced usage).

method.name: IsMutable
method.description: Return TRUE if data can be invalidated; FALSE by default. Requires sub-classing for creating a mutable buffer (advanced usage).

method.name: InvalidatedRange
method.description: Return invalidated range; EMPTY by default. Requires sub-classing for creating a mutable buffer (advanced usage).

method.name: Validate
method.description: Reset invalidated range. Requires sub-classing for creating a mutable buffer (advanced usage).

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
